answer: One proof, one identity, one price: Registered osier sorter bundle file with osier sorters endorsement is the proof, and the price is 3-year training, 150 supervised sortings, market exam, annual re-assessment. One failed proof among 579 burns 116 POA and exposes the cluster, so the farm risks 67164 POA on every epoch. The jetty is stamped by a stranger, the anchor is counted by a ledger, and the atlas is filed by a clerk with no stake in it. One proof per key, one price per proof: that rule alone ends the farm.
